slot.brief: Graham's law: compare rates of effusion of two gases to find molar mass ratio or time ratio

stem: Gases A and B, of molar masses $4$ and $36\ \text{g mol}^{-1}$, effuse through the same pinhole under identical conditions. Find $r_A/r_B$.
notes: from question bank g807aa525c56e (verified in job 20261127-132429-aa8a)
solution:
By Graham’s law, the effusion rate is inversely proportional to the square root of molar mass:
$$\frac{r_A}{r_B}=\sqrt{\frac{M_B}{M_A}}=\sqrt{\frac{36}{4}}=3.$$
